author: feral-core
description: Google Calendar (OAuth2) with ICS URL fallback. List upcoming events, get today's schedule, find the next event, search by query, create events, and delete events. Backend: CalendarIntegration.

endpoints.description: List upcoming events from the user's primary calendar over the next N days. Returns up to 50 events ordered by start time.

params.name: days_ahead
params.description: How many days forward from now to include.

endpoints.returns_description: {events: [{id, summary, description, start, end, location, html_link}], source}

endpoints.description: Return events scheduled for the current calendar day in UTC. Read-only.
endpoints.returns_description: {events: [{id, summary, description, start, end, location, html_link}], date, source}

endpoints.description: Return the single nearest upcoming event from now. Optimised for ambient-strip / glance UIs. Read-only.
endpoints.returns_description: {id, summary, description, start, end, location, html_link} or {message}

endpoints.description: Search the user's calendar for events whose summary or description matches a free-text query, within +/- N days of now.

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text search query. Matches against event title and description.

params.name: days_back
params.description: Half-window in days; the search covers (now - days_back) to (now + days_back).

endpoints.description: Create a new event on the user's primary Google Calendar. Times are RFC3339/ISO8601 strings with timezone (e.g. '2026-05-22T14:00:00-07:00'). Not available when only the ICS fallback is connected.
endpoints.returns_description: {id, summary, description, start, end, location, html_link}

endpoints.description: Delete an event from the user's primary Google Calendar by id. Not available when only the ICS fallback is connected.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Google Calendar event id (the 'id' returned by list_events / next_event / search_events).
